result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 38, 'col': 22}])

def get_avatar_info():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    avatar_b = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b'][0]
    y_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'Y' and min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) > 30]
    b_min = min(p[1] for p in avatar_b['boundary'])
    b_max = max(p[1] for p in avatar_b['boundary'])
    y_col = min(p[1] for p in y_nodes[0]['boundary']) if y_nodes else None
    return (b_min, b_max, y_col)

print(f"After MOUSE click: {get_avatar_info()}")
print(f"Result: {result}")
print(f"Gameplay changed: {result.get('gameplay_changed')}")
print(f"Level completed: {result.get('level_completed')}")
print(f"Game over: {result.get('game_over')}")

# Try moving RIGHT after clicking
result2 = action(['RIGHT'])
pos = get_avatar_info()
print(f"\nAfter RIGHT: {pos}, gameplay_changed={result2.get('gameplay_changed')}")
